source_summary: Sparse monochrome Chinese landscape dominated by broad mist and water washes, distant low mountains, a diagonal right-hand rocky shoreline, and foreground winter trees with small banks and stones. No calligraphy, seals, borders, or paper texture are treated as motifs.

motifs.name: upper_horizontal_mist_bands
motifs.description: Long, pale horizontal mist and sky-wash bands occupying the open upper field, with subtle layered ink tonal shifts and soft horizontal edges.
must_preserve: delicate tonal gradations from tan ground to gray ink
large open negative space without added objects

motifs.name: distant_midground_mountain_wash
motifs.description: Low, dark, hazy mountain mass stretching across the middle distance, strongest on the right and fading leftward into mist, with rounded silhouettes and soft ink wash transitions.
must_preserve: blurred mountain contour along the upper edge

motifs.name: central_pale_river_channel
motifs.description: Light winding river or mist-filled valley cutting upward through the center, bordered by darker banks and distant washes, forming a pale S-shaped negative-water passage.
must_preserve: irregular banks with feathered wash edges
contrast against surrounding dark gray washes

motifs.name: right_stippled_rocky_slope
motifs.description: Steep diagonal rocky slope on the right side, with pale rock face, dark stippled foliage clusters, dot-textured stones, and vertical striated brush marks.
must_preserve: dark shrub masses along the ridge

motifs.name: lower_right_bank_with_reeds
motifs.description: Lower-right shoreline base where the diagonal slope meets the foreground, including dark rootlike strokes, small reeds, scattered dots, and soft shoreline wash.

motifs.name: central_leafless_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Cluster of bare winter trees in the lower center-left, with several dark trunks rising from the bank and angular branches extending outward.
must_preserve: dark ink trunks with varied thickness
surrounding dark shrub wash only where attached

motifs.name: left_foreground_grove_and_rocks
motifs.description: Dark left foreground bank with a leaning bare tree, clustered shrubs, rocks, and heavy ink wash forming a shadowed corner.
must_preserve: rock outlines at the bottom edge

motifs.name: small_riverside_hut_and_bank
motifs.description: Tiny riverside hut or shelter near the lower middle, set into a narrow bank with small dark stones and adjacent low brush marks.
must_preserve: tiny wall shapes in pale reserve

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
